Overview

Kingsport is a city in TN with a population of 55,000. Model City with Bays Mountain Park, the Kingsport Carousel, and a strong manufacturing base. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
